LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.MotorShop.SupplierCatalog
LocaleResource.Value: Imports a supplier catalog package (products.json + images) with categories, brands, sizes and pictures.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value: Upload a catalog package (.zip with products.json and an images folder) from an authorized supplier. Products are matched by SKU. New products, categories and brands are created unpublished: review prices, texts and pictures, then publish them in the catalog. Later imports only update products this supplier's imports created; other products with the same SKU are reported and left unchanged. Pictures are only added to products that have none.

LocaleResource.Name: Package.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Contains products.json and images/*.jpg|png|webp. Max. 512 MB (the server or proxy limit may be lower).

LocaleResource.Name: UpdateExistingProducts
LocaleResource.Value: Update name, description and price of products created by earlier imports of this supplier (published state is kept)

LocaleResource.Name: ImportFailed
LocaleResource.Value: The catalog import failed. See the log for details.

LocaleResource.Name: SupplierName.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Name of the supplier the package comes from, e.g. Motosev. Imported products are marked with it.

LocaleResource.Name: TaxCategory.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Catalog retail prices include KDV. New products get this tax category.

LocaleResource.Name: Result.Conflicts
LocaleResource.Value: Skipped, SKU belongs to another product: {0}
